title: Assessment of Capacity and Earnings in Point-to-Point Transport Sector
what_it_is: Assessment of Capacity and Earnings in Point-to-Point Transport Sector

sections.label: P2P supply, trips and fares
sections.summary: Active PHCs and taxis rose 8% while daily P2P trips rose 1%, moderating fares and drivers' earnings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Between the second quarter of 2023 and the second quarter of 2024, the number of active PHCs and taxis increased by 8%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: However, the average daily number of P2P trips increased by only 1% during the same period.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As a result, P2P fares and consequently drivers' earnings have moderated.

sections.label: Driver supply growth
sections.summary: The supply of drivers increased much faster than the number of trips over the last year till the second quarter.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On the first question, as I have said earlier in my reply, the supply of drivers has increased much faster than the increase in the number of trips over the last one year till the second quarter of this year.

sections.label: Ongoing P2P review
sections.summary: The ongoing P2P review will look at ways to ensure smooth market functioning and reduce friction so drivers match evolving demand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In our ongoing P2P review, we will continue to look at ways to see how we can ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of the market and reduce friction, so that existing as well as new drivers can stay in the sector to match evolving demand.

sections.label: P2P review and leasing contracts
sections.summary: The P2P review is looking at ensuring supply matches evolving demand, including regulations on commissions, fares transparency and platform lock-in.

sentences.speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The second is relating to the vehicle leasing contracts, they are sometimes crafted in a way that makes it difficult for the drivers to exit the contracts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said earlier in my reply, we do not pre-determine supply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we do is to help the market function, as much as possible, efficiently and smoothly, so that supply responds to demand based on price signals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we are undertaking a P2P review and one of the things that we are looking at is how to ensure that supply will continue to match evolving demand, including, for instance, looking even at our regulations and rules about how operators can make sure that their commissions and fares are transparent, and how we can ensure that the drivers are not locked into any platform of the operators, whether these rules and regulations need to be refined, as well as those that we have already announced earlier at the Committee of Supply.
